headline_pain: Think Truganina Is Too Far West?
headline_outcome: 20 Min to CBD. 15 Min to Port.
primary_text: "I need something close to the freeway and port — Truganina ticks that box but is it too far west?" We hear this all the time. Here's the reality: Truganina sits right off the Princes Freeway with direct West Gate Tunnel access into the CBD in under 25 minutes. You're 15 minutes from the Port of Melbourne. Compare that to sitting in traffic from the inner suburbs. These brand-new off-the-plan warehouses put your business on the doorstep of Melbourne's biggest logistics corridor — without the inner-west price tag. The west isn't far. It's fast.
description: Direct Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel access from your warehouse door
